exceptions.reason: The transport-neutral device-sync orchestrator currently selects the Android accessory receive stream and Linux USB host entry point at compile time while preserving one authenticated protocol/session engine. Move this target selection behind a platform-owned device-sync port when direct USB support expands beyond Linux desktop to Android.

Non-Android builds need an unreachable compile-time UsbJoinStream stub so the shared generic join-session type checks without exposing a fake runtime USB fallback. Remove the stub when USB stream construction is fully hidden behind a platform-owned device-sync port.

This module is itself the physical USB transport adapter: Linux owns libusb/AOA host I/O and Android owns the raw accessory file-descriptor stream. Move the OS-specific implementations under the central platform module when additional desktop/mobile USB adapters are introduced.

The command facade must delegate desktop path dialogs and Android URI streaming while preserving one shared transfer ledger and IPC name. Move the target selection into a platform-owned command adapter when the iOS implementation is added.
Linux must create the main Tauri window with the embedded raccoon icon before GTK maps the window. Other desktop targets keep Tauri's configured automatic window construction.
